_about: The ONE definition of the two stock level statuses. backend/utils/stockStatus.js reads this file; the owner can change the percentages in Settings > Stock Level Thresholds (table forecast_config). Hand-worked examples live in backend/tests/fixtures/stock_status_cases.json.

current._about: Current Stock Level Status: a real-time check of the stock on hand against the ingredient's ideal stock level (ingredients.min_stock). Stock % = current stock / ideal stock level x 100. Out of Stock: stock <= 0. Low Stock: 0% < Stock % < low threshold (wet or dry). Normal Stock: low threshold <= Stock % <= 100%. Excess Stock: Stock % > 100%.

predicted._about: Predicted Stock Level Status: after a forecast is generated, the stock on hand is compared against the forecasted demand. Coverage % = current stock / forecasted demand x 100. Critical Shortage: Coverage % < critical threshold. Insufficient Supply: Coverage % < sufficient threshold. Sufficient Supply: sufficient threshold <= Coverage % <= above threshold. Above Forecast Limit: Coverage % > above threshold. Unassigned: no forecasted demand (not in any recipe, or no forecast yet).

actions.insufficient: Order soon — stock is running low
actions.sufficient: No action needed — stock is sufficient
actions.unassigned: No forecasted demand for this ingredient yet
